description: Finds contacts by exact email, status or tag, newest first. Free and read only. Status "subscribed" means active; "unsubscribed" covers suppressed addresses. Returns at most `limit` rows (default 50, max 200). Requires API key scope: read.

email.description: Exact email address to look up.

limit.description: How many rows to return (1 to 200, default 50).

status.description: Filter by status. subscribed = active, unsubscribed = suppressed.

tag.description: Only contacts that carry this tag.

name: contacts_search
title: Search contacts
